statement: What is the tens digit of 3 to the power 2026?

choices.misconception: I used the cycle of last digits of powers of 3, which has length 4, for the last two digits too; 2026 leaves remainder 2, so I took 3 squared = 09.
I found that the last two digits repeat every 20 powers, but miscounted my place in the cycle by one and used 3 to the power 5 = 243.
I multiplied 3 by 2026 to get 6078 instead of raising 3 to the power 2026.
I found that the last two digits are 29 but gave the units digit instead of the tens digit.

hints: Track only the last two digits of each power of 3.
Multiply by 3 again and again, keeping just the last two digits. Look for a power ending in 01; from there the pattern repeats, and the remainder of 2026 tells you where you land.
3 to the power 10 ends in 49, so 3 to the power 20 ends in 01.

solutions.reliable: The last two digits of the powers of 3 are 03, 09, 27, 81, 43, 29, 87, 61, 83, 49, 47, 41, 23, 69, 07, 21, 63, 89, 67, 01. So 3 to the power 20 ends in 01 and the pattern repeats every 20 powers. Since 2026 = 20 x 101 + 6, 3 to the power 2026 ends like 3 to the power 6 = 729, in 29. The tens digit is 2. The transferable idea: the last two digits of powers cycle just like the last digit does, but the cycle can be longer, so find where it truly restarts.
solutions.elegant: 3 to the power 10 = 59049 ends in 49, and 49 x 49 = 2401 ends in 01, so 3 to the power 20 ends in 01 without listing every step.

whyOnTest: The last digit of powers of 3 cycles every 4, but the last two digits cycle every 20; using the short cycle for the long job is the trap.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
